items.raw_excerpt: Back when beauty was top of mind for the citizens, a stunning water statue in Lisbon was created.
items.summary_en: A beautiful water statue called the Fountain of Venus stands in Lisbon. It was created when the city cared deeply about beauty and art. The fountain remains a charming piece of the city's history.

items.summary_en: Football player Luis Jiménez showed his new tattoo. People are joking about it, saying it needs a bit of stucco. The jokes mean the tattoo looks rough and badly done.

items.raw_excerpt: Nearly three decades after setting off with little more than a backpack and skateboard, Mr Dasuki Johari reflects on the choices he made that had him sleeping in mosques and working on prawning boats.
items.summary_en: Dasuki Johari once won a medal for Singapore in para-athletics. Nearly three decades later, he lives in Kuala Lumpur and sells art on the streets. He reflects on his journey from sleeping in mosques to working on prawning boats.

items.raw_excerpt: Kochi airport introduces a robotic assistant to enhance passenger experience and promote Kerala's cultural heritage.
items.summary_en: Kochi airport in India has introduced a new robot assistant. The robot helps passengers navigate the airport and learn about Kerala culture. Airport officials say it will improve the travel experience.

items.raw_excerpt: Robots and AI are entering Icelandic elder care as operators look for ways to ease staffing pressure without replacing professional care.
items.summary_en: Nursing homes in Iceland are turning to AI and robots to help care for elderly residents. The technology is being used to ease pressure on staff without replacing professional caregivers. This comes as the country faces ongoing shortages of care workers.
items.summary_ko: 아이슬란드의 요양원들이 고령자 돌봄을 돕기 위해 AI와 로봇 기술을 도입하고 있습니다. 해당 기술은 전문 간호 인력을 대체하지 않으면서 업무 부담을 줄이는 데 활용되고 있습니다. 아이슬란드는 돌봄 인력 부족이 지속되면서 이러한 해결책을 모색하고 있습니다.

items.summary_en: Several young women received medical treatment during the traditional Reed Dance in KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa. The maidens experienced only minor health complications during the annual cultural event.

items.raw_excerpt: Residents of a South Delhi slum express frustration over government efforts to conceal poverty during the BRICS Summit instead of providing support.
items.summary_en: Residents of a South Delhi slum are upset that the government covered their neighborhood during the BRICS Summit. The authorities tried to hide poverty from visiting leaders instead of helping the community.

items.raw_excerpt: Every year, the people of San Juan de la Vega honor their patron saint by packing explosives on to sledgehammers and detonating them.
items.summary_en: Every year the people of San Juan de la Vega, Guanajuato honor their patron saint by strapping explosives to sledgehammers and smashing them on the ground. The loud, dangerous ritual is a cherished local tradition in this small Mexican town.

items.title_en: Explosive Sledgehammer Festival in San Juan de la Vega

items.summary_en: Xhosa maidens joined thousands of girls at this year's Reed Dance in KwaZulu-Natal. It is a traditional ceremony where young women come together to honor their culture.

items.raw_excerpt: Most of us choose colours because we like the way they look. We paint a room because a particular shade appeals to us, choose clothes because they suit us, or add colour to our homes simply because it makes them more attractive.
items.summary_en: We often choose colours just because we like how they look. We pick paint, clothes, and home colours mostly for their beauty. But colours may also affect how we feel and live.
items.summary_ko: 우리는 대부분 색이 예뻐 보여서 색을 고릅니다. 벽이나 옷, 집을 꾸밀 때도 주로 아름다움 때문에 색을 선택합니다. 하지만 색은 우리의 기분과 생활에도 영향을 줄 수 있습니다.
items.title_en: The hidden power of colour: Could the colours around us affect our lives?
items.title_ko: 색깔의 숨은 힘: 주변의 색이 우리 삶에 영향을 줄까?

items.raw_excerpt: This year's Animal Blessing Service will be led by The Reverend Carla Vicêncio Prior, who has served as Chaplain in Central and Eastern Algarve since 2024.
items.summary_en: The Reverend Carla Vicêncio Prior will lead this year's Animal Blessing Service. She has served as Chaplain in Central and Eastern Algarve since 2024. This community event welcomes local pets for a special blessing.

items.raw_excerpt: Researchers analyzed Parks Canada data collected from 2010 to 2023 on aggressive wildlife encounters and what people were doing when they occurred. The researchers found that quiet activities like hiking, walking and sightseeing were when many encounters occurred.
items.summary_en: A study of Parks Canada data from 2010 to 2023 found that elk were involved in nearly two-thirds of aggressive wildlife encounters in national parks. Researchers said quiet activities like hiking and sightseeing were the most common situations when encounters happened.
items.summary_ko: 캐나다 국립공원공사의 2010년부터 2023년까지 데이터를 분석한 연구에 따르면, 공격적인 야생동물과의 만남 중 거의 3분의 2에 말이 관여한 것으로 나타났다. 등산이나 관광 같은 조용한 활동 중에 만남이 가장 자주 발생했다고 연구팀은 밝혔다.
items.title_en: Elk in two-thirds of aggressive wildlife encounters in Canadian national parks
items.title_ko: 캐나다 국립공원 공격적 야생동물 만남의 3분의 2에 말이 관여
items.title_original: Elk involved in nearly two-thirds of aggressive encounters in national parks, study finds

items.raw_excerpt: BJP may rise to second-largest party in Meghalaya as eight UDP MLAs reportedly plan to switch allegiance.
items.summary_en: BJP may become the second-largest party in Meghalaya state. Eight UDP MLAs are reportedly planning to switch their allegiance to BJP. This political shift could change the balance of power in the northeastern Indian state.

items.title_en: Mawthoh joins BJP; eight UDP MLAs may follow in Meghalaya
